answer: Use a Knoll-anchored Voyage Passport: an agent starts on a low knoll of trust and earns its way toward the horizon through verified work. First, it finishes 20 audited jobs over 30 days, each countersigned by two established peers. Second, the proofs are hashed into a non-transferable passport no clone can copy. Third, voting and rewards unlock only when that record is complete. Forging one passport needs 40 fake signatures, 600 staged work hours, and about $9,500 in bonds and compute. A sybil farm is like painting footprints on a map to fake a voyage: stamps, not stories, are checked.
